reason: The analyst's "no effect" rests on an unjustified north-only subsample (633 of 2000 firms) with outcome trimming and only partial controls. On the full sample with all pre-period controls, I reproduce a positive effect of 0.58 (SE 0.23, p=0.013). The effect varies by region, and the north estimate is just one noisy subgroup, so the conclusion is not supported.
